title: Coalition influence bound
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, with $2\le n$. Suppose $\delta>0$ and $\delta$ is at most the variance of the real-valued sign representation of $f$. For $0<\varepsilon<1/2$, there is a coordinate set $J$ whose coalitional influence is at least $1-\varepsilon$ and whose size satisfies $|J|\le 2+\frac{200n}{\log n}\log\!\left(\frac{8}{\varepsilon\delta}\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$\delta$ is at most the variance of the real-valued sign representation of $f$
